accommodation: En-suite guest rooms (site states 5 in one place, 2 first-floor rooms in another; rooms 1 and 2 have balconies) plus a two-bedroom self-catering apartment
suitableFor: Couples and small groups wanting to be right by the beach; the apartment suits self-caterers
beachAccess: Site states the beach is 50-100 yards away
confirmedFeatures: Conservatory with seating, patio, free Wi-Fi, guest fridge, sea views
overview: A guest house at Riviere Towans in Phillack, on the Hayle side of St Ives Bay, offering room-only en-suite bedrooms, some with balconies, and a separate self-catering apartment. The sands of the Towans are only a short stroll from the door.
surfTripFit: Being a minute or two from the Hayle Towans beach with free parking makes it an easy base for surfing St Ives Bay.
gaps: Room count inconsistent on site; breakfast appears not included; dogs and board storage not stated; trading inferred from live booking.
